035-A_CausalInvariant.findings: Zero lookahead leakage verified. predict() is strictly idempotent and excludes current/future observations from historical window.

035-B_NumericalFuzzing.findings: Insufficient lookback (< 120), zero variance (flat prices), and negative/corrupt prices fail closed without runtime exceptions.

035-C_NegativeDirectionalControl.findings: ReversedRatioZScoreModel consistently inverts CALL/PUT directional signals, ensuring negative control symmetry.

035-D_SyntheticNullMulberry32.findings: Geometric Brownian motion produced win rate consistent with random walk (within [40%, 60%]) with Wilson lower bound strictly below breakeven.

035-E_WilsonScoreProperties.findings: Analytical Wilson confidence interval computation verified against known mathematical bounds.
